tasks.short: Conduct applied molecular and cellular research

steps.what: Define the actual applied research question, controls, evidence needed and authorised study scope for an improvement such as crop quality, resolving feasibility and access with responsible specialists.
inputs: actual prior evidence and research permissions

steps.what: Conduct applied research aimed at improvements in areas such as disease testing, crop quality, pharmaceuticals and the harnessing of microbes to recycle waste, performing the actual authorised observations and experimental work within established laboratory controls.
inputs: actual authorised study materials and conditions

steps.what: Capture actual sample identifiers, conditions, measurements, controls and deviations in the electronic laboratory notebook {OTHER}, retaining manual entries and source verification where no authorised instrument output is available.

Prepare the specified research summaries and control comparisons in the laboratory analysis software {OTHER}; native reusable calculation and plot definitions reduce repeated active setup while retaining mapping and calculation checks.
Interpret the actual results against controls, uncertainty and the applied research question, deciding whether an apparent improvement is supported and what further research is needed.
Write the actual research conclusion and limitation entry in the electronic laboratory notebook {OTHER}, checking the completed source data, summaries, conclusion, study version and access scope.
Commit the exact checked completed research record to the restricted electronic laboratory notebook {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Test native analysis templates in the laboratory software {OTHER} first. Keep research design, physical experiments, actual data capture and interpretation human; reduce only repeated summary setup before completing the real study record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applied improvement depends on experimental evidence rather than a plausible generated proposal.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calculations and plots can reuse explicit study definitions.
tasks.still_hard: Controls, variability and whether the actual results justify an applied claim.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist designs informative research and recognises unsupported improvement claims.

ambition.what: No new biological capability or production process is proposed.

tasks.altitude: A small reduction in analysis setup leaves physical research and scientific responsibility unchanged.

reach.learn: Separate an observed effect from a reproducible useful improvement.

evidence.claim: Native laboratory calculation templates can reduce repeated summary setup without replacing experiments or interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary: an authorised applied-research cycle, illustrated by nonclinical crop-quality work; distinct assay development in 16811 is not duplicated. No new hazardous work, clinical testing procedure or production deployment is designed here.

The biologist creates the actual study design and observations in s1-s2. Source capture in s3 includes sample ID, time, units, controls, conditions and deviations, with manual entry and verification when instrument data are unavailable; no clean result feed is free.

s2-s3 can alternate during experiments; each actual observation exists before it is recorded. s3 and s6 are draft record content until the completed commit in s7; no earlier hidden record save is credited.
The ordinary completed-record check in s6 supplies the requested commit gate without added approval labour; changed data, conclusions or study version invalidate it.
Shares and cuts are illustrative E1 estimates, not measured baselines. Native facilities are tested first; existing computation runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Actual study mix and current analysis templates
Required laboratory record and review controls
research_questions: Does repeated active summary setup remain after current instrument and notebook functions?

already_counted.description: Study design, physical work, actual capture, calculation checks, interpretation and completed record remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain calculation definitions and representative result checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual data, summaries and completed study conclusion checked in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 5 less 1 upkeep yields net 4 where summary setup repeats manually. Existing templates or primarily physical investigation yield no gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find and verify the original controlled standards, institutional responsibilities and existing approved procedural guidance in {DOCS}; native version links reduce repeated navigation while retaining full source reading.

Determine the guideline's actual scope, applicable responsibilities, risk-review needs and unresolved requirements with the responsible scientific and safety specialists; do not infer that a generic source authorises local practice.
inputs: actual institutional requirements and specialist review

steps.what: Develop guidelines for procedures such as the management of viruses in {DOCS}; native controlled-document templates reuse approved source references, responsibilities and review headings while the biologist writes the actual scope, limitations and review questions without generating unapproved technical procedures.

Review and correct the complete guideline draft against original approved sources and actual specialist requirements, checking meaning, scope, omissions, unresolved issues, source versions and restricted development status.
Save the exact checked guideline development version in restricted {DOCS}, explicitly awaiting the institution's required approval rather than releasing it as an operational procedure.

tasks.design: Configure native controlled-document templates and version links in {DOCS}. Reuse only verified administrative structure and source references; keep scientific and safety interpretation human and stop at a controlled development draft.
tasks.previous_blocker: Document assembly does not establish that a procedure is appropriate or authorised.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can preserve source versions and review structure without generating technical instructions.
tasks.still_hard: Local applicability, missing requirements and institutional responsibility.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist and responsible specialists identify what remains unresolved before operational approval.

ambition.what: No new biological procedure or approval authority is proposed.

tasks.altitude: Less document assembly leaves more attention for requirements; operational approval remains separate.

reach.learn: Distinguish a development draft from an approved local procedure.

evidence.claim: Controlled templates and source links can reduce document assembly while applicability and approval require responsible human review.

assumptions: Boundary: guideline development to an internal controlled draft, consistent with this task's drafting authority. Operational authorisation, publication and implementation are separate workflows and earn no saving; no biological handling instructions are supplied here.

Standard owners supply document identity, revision, applicable scope and approved content; institutional specialists supply actual responsibilities and review requirements. The biologist verifies originals in s1-s2 and manually resolves missing requirements; no clean approved guideline is free.
Native templates are tested first. Only repeated navigation and administrative document assembly lose time; scientific requirements and full meaning review remain. No model invents procedures.
The ordinary completed-draft check in s4 supplies the requested internal-save gate without added self-approval labour. Changed contents, source version or development status invalidate it.
Shares and reductions are illustrative E1 estimates, not measured baselines; actual legal and national requirements must be verified by responsible staff.
unknowns: Current controlled templates and required specialist reviews
research_questions: Which administrative fields repeat without scientific alteration?

already_counted.description: Source verification, specialist requirements, substantive writing, full review and draft save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain controlled template fields and source-version links.

approvals.approved_version: Exact checked guideline draft, source versions and restricted development status checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 12 less 1.5 upkeep yields net 10.5 for repeated document navigation and administrative assembly. Existing controlled templates yield no additional return.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define the actual cell characteristic, research purpose, permitted samples, existing method evidence and performance requirements for the assay with responsible researchers.
inputs: actual permitted samples and method evidence

steps.what: Develop the justified assay concept and validation criteria, choosing appropriate controls and recognising specificity, variability and measurement limits without substituting generated plausibility for experimental evidence.

Develop assays that monitor cell characteristics through actual authorised laboratory trials and observations, following existing approved laboratory controls and responding to real experimental failures.
inputs: actual authorised trial materials and conditions

steps.what: Record actual trial sample identities, conditions, measurements, control results and deviations in the electronic laboratory notebook {OTHER}, verifying manual or instrument-origin fields against actual observations.

Prepare specified trial comparison tables and plots in the laboratory analysis software {OTHER}; native templates reduce repeated active setup while retaining source mapping, units and numerical verification against actual controls.
Evaluate actual assay performance against the specified criteria, decide whether results support its intended research use and identify unresolved limits or further validation needs.

Write the actual assay-development conclusion and limitation note in the electronic laboratory notebook {OTHER}, checking the completed design, raw trial record, summaries and conclusion as one versioned research package.
Commit the exact checked assay-development package in the restricted laboratory notebook {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure native assay comparison tables and plots in the laboratory software {OTHER}. Retain assay design, physical trials, actual source capture and performance judgement, with a separate completed-record commit rather than automatic validation approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assay performance must be demonstrated by actual controlled observations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can repeat specified comparisons without designing the assay.
tasks.still_hard: Specificity, variability and whether the intended characteristic is measured reliably.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist interprets controls and recognises an assay that needs further work.

ambition.what: No new assay capability or diagnostic use is promised.

tasks.altitude: A small reduction in plot setup leaves experimental development and scientific responsibility unchanged.

reach.learn: Compare actual results with independently specified acceptance criteria.

evidence.claim: Native comparison templates can reduce repeated trial-summary setup while assay validity requires real experiments and scientific judgement.

assumptions: Boundary: research assay development through its actual internal record, not clinical diagnostic authorisation, routine production testing or task 16816's separate applied study. No technical biological procedure is specified here.

The scientist produces design and criteria in s1-s2, actual observations in s3 and verified sample IDs, conditions, units, controls and deviations in s4. Missing source data are manually recorded or clarified in that retained work; no clean instrument feed is assumed.
Trial and draft capture can alternate. s4 and s7 create record content before the explicit completed-package commit in s8; source writing is not hidden inside physical experimentation.
The normal completed-package check in s7 supplies the requested commit gate without added approval labour; changed trials, design, conclusions or versions invalidate it.
Shares and reductions are E1 scenarios, not measured baselines. Native configuration is tried first; existing numerical runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Actual assay types and existing comparison templates
Required independent validation and record controls
research_questions: Does active comparison setup repeat separately from experimental judgement?

already_counted.description: Requirements, assay design, physical trials, actual capture, calculation checks, evaluation and final record remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain comparison definitions and representative numerical checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact assay design, actual trial data, summaries and conclusion checked in s7

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 4 less 1 upkeep yields net 3 where active summary setup repeats. Already-configured assays yield no new gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find and verify the current research plans, sample dependencies, actual progress and method versions in {PROJECT} and {DOCS}; native project links reduce repeated navigation while retaining source checks and missing-input follow-up.

Coordinate molecular or cellular research activities with scientists specializing in other fields, resolve incompatible assumptions and sample or method dependencies, discuss actual progress and agree feasible next work within each discipline's responsibilities.
outputs: actual joint research decisions and dependencies

steps.what: Write the actual joint research coordination note in {DOCS}; native fields reuse verified study, sample and method-version references while the scientist writes and checks the completed decisions, dependencies, owners, dates and recipients.
inputs: actual joint research decisions and dependencies

steps.what: Save the exact checked joint research coordination note in {DOCS}.
Send the exact checked research coordination note to the identified scientific owners through {EMAIL}.

tasks.design: Configure native {PROJECT} source links and factual {DOCS} fields before adding a coordination assistant. Keep cross-disciplinary judgement and the actual decisions human, followed by distinct final-version save and send actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Disciplines use different assumptions, method versions and evidence of progress.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and controlled fields can reduce repeated context assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving incompatible scientific assumptions and uncertain dependencies.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist checks what collaborators actually mean and negotiates defensible next work.

ambition.what: No new programme or additional project authority is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less context assembly leaves more attention for unresolved dependencies.

reach.learn: Specify data and method dependencies across disciplinary boundaries.

evidence.claim: Native project links and document fields can reduce coordination preparation without replacing scientific agreement.

assumptions: Boundary: coordination and its actual decision note, not other scientists' experimental work, sample transfer or performance of the agreed research. No outside-role saving is counted.

Collaborators supply study/sample IDs, method versions, actual status, dependency, owner and timing constraints; the scientist verifies originals and manually seeks missing facts in s1-s2. Actual joint decisions exist only after s2, not from the scheduled meeting ending.

Native configuration is tested first. The normal completed-note check in s3 binds each requested save/send gate without added approval labour; changed findings, versions or recipients invalidate both.
Shares and reductions are illustrative E1 scenarios, not measured baselines. Substantive judgement and writing remain counted; no existing system-runtime saving is claimed.
unknowns: Current study links and factual document reuse
Actual coordination record and access obligations
research_questions: Which identifiers are truly copied repeatedly into actual research coordination records?

already_counted.description: Source verification, actual coordination, substantive writing and final actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source links, factual fields and access.

approvals.approved_version: Exact research coordination note and internal record checked in s3
Exact research decisions, dependencies and recipient owners checked in s3
